title: Shardtastic
description: Shards that can be obtained and used for epic loot!
body:
Shardtastic adds a set of shard items that can be used to roll custom loot tables, giving players a fun and expandable way to obtain themed rewards through item use.

### Features

- Shard items that can be right-clicked to receive loot

- Multiple shard types (nature, combat, weak/normal/strong variants)

- Custom loot tables per shard

- Rarity-based feedback, including different particles and sounds
